ios.desc:
Countdown to your life's most special moments.

It’s the small things in life that matter most – birthdays, anniversaries, weddings, and heartwarming gatherings with your favorite people. With TimeCount, you can easily countdown and cherish these unforgettable occasions.

Countdown and More!
Keep track of your important events, whether you're counting down to a vacation or celebrating your wedding anniversary.

Your Personal Countdown Calendar
View all your life events on a single screen, swipe through them effortlessly, and enjoy beautiful full-screen event photos.

Home Screen Countdown Widgets
Countdown to your events right from your home screen with our stunning widgets.

Never Miss a Beat
TimeCount lets you countdown to events that happen yearly, monthly, weekly, or daily. You'll never forget birthdays and anniversaries again!

Countdown Reminders
We'll keep you informed about how much time remains until your event, all without opening the app.

A Beautiful Countdown Experience
TimeCount is designed with care and attention. Enjoy subtle animations and beautiful imagery that make your countdown experience the best it can be.

Unlimited Free Mode
Countdown to many events as you want: Birthday, Vacation, Holiday, Christmas, Wedding, Anniversary, Retirement, Concert and more.

And Much More
TimeCount is available for free because we want you to experience it. We're continually working on new features and value your feedback. Try TimeCount now and find out why our users believe it's the ultimate countdown app on the App Store. It's the countdown app that makes your events even more exciting!

show_hn.title: Show HN: I Made an Event Countdown App in React Native

quotes.text:
I recently created an Events Countdown app for iOS.
Basically, user can create event like Birthday, Anniversary, ... and the app will show a countdown time until or since the event.
User can also add reminder days, weeks, months before or after the event.

It's not shown in the video but the user can choose different display mode like: List, Grid or Carousel and sizes,...

This is my first time trying this business model my apps. It's free to use. You can create unlimited number of events, reminders, you can switch between dark/light theme... All the core features of an Event Countdown apps are free. But there are interstitial ads after the user created an event once in a while. (using facebook audience network and google admob).

Some premium features like layouts, online gallery, cloud syncing,... are unlocked through a subscription monthly or yearly.

I created the project with [typescript-react-native-starter](https://github.com/NewBieBR/typescript-react-native-starter).

I also tried to contribute some open-source components like:

- [react-native-easy-icon](https://github.com/NewBieBR/react-native-easy-icon): wrapper component of react-native-vector-icons to use icon easily

- [react-native-unsplash](https://github.com/NewBieBR/react-native-unsplash): The online gallery feature that you see from the video use directly this component. It's basically a photos browser using the unsplash api.
